title: Average American Rates Their Home 7.5 Out of 10
paragraphs: How much do you like your home? A new survey asked people in the US this question.
The survey was done by Talker Research for Chase Home Lending, a company that helps people buy homes. In June 2026, it asked 2,000 people who own their homes.

On average, the people gave their homes a score of 7.5 out of 10. Most of them were happy. Two out of three people said they still love their home as much as when they got it. Also, 54% said they could live in their home for more than 15 years.

But not everyone was happy. About 20% of the people said they were thinking about leaving their home. Some said their money situation had changed. Others said their home needed too many repairs. People also named some warning signs, such as animals moving into the home (19%), noisy neighbors (17%) and cracks in the walls (17%). However, many people do not want to leave because they would miss their memories.
What do people like most about their homes? The backyard was the top answer, at 40%. The living room was second, at 39%. The size of the kitchen was third, at 33%.

Many people also want to make their home better. About 46% said they are trying to turn their home into their dream home. The most popular first jobs were working on the yard and updating the kitchen.
The typical home in the survey had three bedrooms and two bathrooms.
